title: In an abstract ordered ring, multiplying a nonneg-vs-le pair on the left preserves the order
statement: For any ordered-ring record R (a ring plus le, le_refl, le_trans, le_antisymm, add_le_add_left, mul_nonneg) and elements a b c of R's carrier, if 0 <= a and b <= c then a*b <= a*c.

formal.statement: theorem Alg.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left : ((x0 : Alg.OrderedRing) -> ((x1 : Alg.OrderedRing.carrier x0) -> ((x2 : Alg.OrderedRing.carrier x0) -> ((x3 : Alg.OrderedRing.carrier x0) -> ((x4 : Alg.OrderedRing.le x0 (Alg.OrderedRing.zero x0) x1) -> ((x5 : Alg.OrderedRing.le x0 x2 x3) -> Alg.OrderedRing.le x0 (Alg.OrderedRing.mul x0 x1 x2) (Alg.OrderedRing.mul x0 x1 x3)))))))

evidence.supports: Alg.OrderedRing (Ring's 15 fields restated plus le and five order laws: le_refl, le_trans, le_antisymm, add_le_add_left, mul_nonneg -- 21 fields total, admits at Sort 2 with the same universe-guard control every other record in the spine carries) and Alg.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left both admit through the trusted kernel gate. Instantiated at Int.orderedRing and Rat.orderedRing (Rat's add_le_add_left has no primitive and is DERIVED from add_le_add + le_refl), type-checking symbolically (closed over free a b c and both hypothesis fvars) at both. Proof: d := add (neg b) c is shown >=0 (add_le_add_left + a transport along the derived add(neg b)b=zero); b+d=c (assoc + negAdd + a derived left-unit); so a*c=a*b+a*d (distribL); a*d>=0 (mul_nonneg), so a*b <= a*b+a*d = a*c (add_le_add_left again).
